given: the full set of sprint-1 stock records prior to the migration
when: the up migration runs to completion
then: every stock row still exists with the same identity and unchanged canonical location — the row count is unchanged and no row is lost or corrupted

independence.rationale: AC1 and AC2 concern the correctness of the extracted batch/serial values; this asserts the distinct no-data-loss outcome (row count preserved, location untouched). Backfill values could be correct while rows are dropped or location overwritten, and vice versa, so it is independently breakable.
